subject: strange error-message at some MI-models referencing "dimnames"

messages.author: 72ebbe9bcb85eab4
messages.subject: strange error-message at some MI-models referencing "dimnames"
parts:
Hi all,

I've calculated a multiple imputation with mice and ran afterwards some models using semTools and lavaan (semTools::sem.mi) and a dataset as (Large) mitml.list. All my latent models run properly, but when i run the same models as manifest models with mean-scores out of the same mitml.list, calculation itself seems to work, but when I want to see the results with summary(), i get the following error-message: 

Error in dimnames(Implied[[b]][[nm]]) <- list(NAMES, NAMES) : 
  'dimnames' applied to non-array

I'm very confused, because it sounds like a problem with a wrongly formatted list, but even if i run a model with pseudo-factors (1 indicator per factor, loading = 1, residual variance = 0) using exactly the same mean-scores as indicators, everything works properly again, gigving me again the results with summary() without such an error-message (unless there is a message that there are Heywood cases, what in my opinion could be a result of the pseudo-factors).

Does anybody have an idea, what could be the problem with the manifest models?


Thanks for all!

Edgar

messages.author: 72ebbe9bcb85eab4
messages.subject: Re: strange error-message at some MI-models referencing "dimnames"
parts:
Hi all,

I found my fault: I had used fit.measures = TRUE. Without this option, which is a bit senseless at my manifest model, because it's not overidentified, everything works ..

Edgar
.
